name: declarative-hex-worlds-workspace
description: Workspace root for declarative-hex-worlds. Only packages/declarative-hex-worlds is published; examples and Sourcey docs are private consumers.

scripts.docs:dev: pnpm --filter declarative-hex-worlds exec tsx scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts && pnpm --filter @declarative-hex-worlds/docs dev
scripts.docs:build: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm --filter declarative-hex-worlds build && pnpm --filter declarative-hex-worlds exec tsx scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts && pnpm --filter @declarative-hex-worlds/docs build
scripts.docs:validate: pnpm --filter declarative-hex-worlds exec tsx scripts/generate-cli-reference.ts && pnpm --filter @declarative-hex-worlds/docs validate
